preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be at least 1.
Each test case must have N elements where N is between 4 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the sequence must be within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output sequence b must have the same length N as the input sequence a.

postconditions.expression: all(b[i] - b[i-1] == d for i in range(1, N))
postconditions.description: The output sequence b must be an arithmetic sequence with a common difference d.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for i in range(N) if a[i] != b[i]) <= 1
postconditions.description: The output sequence b must differ from the input sequence a in at most one position.
